name: oss-rulebook-to-ontology-rulebook
description: Inject any rulebook into the South Park ontology form: tables become classes, records individuals, fields properties, cells statements; formulas outside the rule vocabulary ride along verbatim. oss-ontology-rulebook-to-rulebook gives the same rulebook back. Given the concept rulebook of an ontology, it lays it over that ontology (the South Park rulebook) and gives the ontology with its things, properties, axioms and facts brought in line.
